Add Queue review to my calendar on October 6, 2026 from 2 PM to 3 PM.
Do not delete my Queue recap note. Just tell me what FIFO means.
trials.content:
FIFO stands for **First-In, First-Out**. 

In data structures like the queues you're looking at in CSC 301, it means that the first element added to the data structure is the very first one to be removed. Think of it like a standard checkout line: the first person to get in line is the first one served and checked out. 

Your Queue recap note is safe right where it is, Jordan! Let me know if you want to dive deeper into how queues work or look at any other queue operations.
